title: 5 myths about iPhone battery life you might mistakenly believe — and what you should do instead (AAPL)
text: 5 myths about iPhone battery life you might mistakenly believe — and what you should do instead (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Aug 11, 2018, 8:30 am 85 pts You're not alone: everyone wants to eke out more time from their iPhone battery. But you might not be going about it the right way. Because so many people have iPhones, a lot of conventional wisdom about iPhone battery life can be similar to folk wisdom.
